title: Healio: Expanding Screening Choices to Help Close the Colorectal Cancer Gap
summary: In a recent Healio article, Dr. Brian Caveney, Labcorp's chief medical and scientific officer, highlights a key challenge: nearly one-quarter of eligible U.S. adults remain unscreened for colorectal cancer.
body_markdown:
In a recent *Healio* **** article, **Dr. Brian Caveney** , Labcorp's chief medical and scientific officer, highlights a key challenge: nearly one-quarter of eligible U.S. adults remain unscreened for colorectal cancer.


**Key takeaway:** Screening participation may improve when patients can choose from options that align with their preferences.


Research conducted by Labcorp and cited in the article found that many adults, particularly those who have never been screened, prefer at-home testing options. Convenience, accessibility and comfort can influence whether screening gets completed.


**Why it matters:** As colorectal cancer rates rise among younger adults, expanding access to patient-preferred screening options may help support earlier detection and improved outcomes.


**Read the full article in**[Healio](https://www.healio.com/news/gastroenterology/20260914/closing-the-colorectal-screening-gap-starts-with-matching-options-to-patient-preference) **.** ****
